title: The Great Retreat
reviewNotes: Montage, captions and native complete later boards reviewed. Begin after ...h2 at 174 seconds in the complete eight-piece later diagram: White Ka5/Rc2/a2/b3 against Ka3/b5/b4/h2. The source Rc1 is certified against every legal Black reply, including all four promotions and the king moves, through exact seven-piece winning captures. Subsequent replies are explicitly independently supplied representative completions; the source stops after Rc1. The earlier larger rook retreat and stalemate-squeeze sequence remain outside this proof. All five pawns are preserved until an actual capture.
